video_title: 🏆Lakers vs Kings | Postgame Interviews x Highlights: November 20, 2026

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on the importance of re-signing D'Angelo Russell
quotes.excerpt: the number one priority for us was to re-sign D'Angelo Russell and put complimentary players around Luka Doncic
quotes.quote: When we put this team together, the number one priority for us was to re-sign D'Angelo Russell and put complimentary players around Luka Doncic. We basically have played three quarters of a game in the last seven games with the two of them both available and we've gone six and one. It's a credit to the group sticking with it. Basketball is a game of mistakes. We played through some mistakes tonight just like we did the other night against Charlotte.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick says the Lakers priority was to re-sign D'Angelo Russell to pair with Luka Doncic. The team is 6-1 when both are available.

structured.context: JJ Redick discusses the team's roster construction and the importance of re-signing D'Angelo Russell during his postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on how Luka Doncic's performance builds team trust
quotes.excerpt: It builds trust with the staff, it builds trust with his teammates, most importantly it builds trust
quotes.quote: It builds trust with the staff, it builds trust with his teammates, most importantly it builds trust with our star players. That's the biggest thing. For him, the reference point thing is a simple thing I always go back to. I played and was part of six teams in 15 years and anytime you go to a new team, you can have reference points in your career, but you need reference points with that group and with those teammates and those coaches, and it gives you not only a sense of confidence, but I really believe it gives you like a sense of belonging.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on the importance of building trust and reference points with a new group: It gives players a sense of belonging.

structured.context: JJ Redick explains how Luka Doncic's performance helps build trust and a sense of belonging within the team.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on using a Rory McIlroy quote to motivate players
quotes.excerpt: when you're not playing well, it feels like your good game is so far away
quotes.quote: I actually used the Rory McIlroy quote before the game with those guys. The Rory quote is basically, when you're not playing well, it feels like your good game is so far away and then once you start playing well, you realize it was never that far away to begin with. I love that quote.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick shared a Rory McIlroy quote with the Lakers to motivate them: When you are not playing well it feels like your good game is far away, but once you start playing well you realize it was never that far away.

structured.context: JJ Redick shares a motivational quote from Rory McIlroy that he used to address the team before the game.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the Lakers fans' expectations and team effort
quotes.excerpt: it's not so much making shots, but just playing with effort and energy
quotes.quote: I understand that the LA fans expect a certain kind of performance and I think it's not so much making shots, but just playing with effort and energy and I can completely respect that. I think that Lakers fans are the best in the world. Obviously, they're some of the most numerous, but yeah, even coming off the bench or coming out of the game last game, hearing the fans, it wasn't deconstructive. It was just like, come on, you got to play harder and they were absolutely right.
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler on Lakers fans telling him to play harder: They were absolutely right.

structured.context: Walker Kessler reacts to Lakers fans demanding more effort and energy during his postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the team's next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: it's just next man up mentality. I think some players play more minutes with AR out
quotes.quote: It's just next man up mentality. I think some players play more minutes with AR out, so everybody's prepared, is ready and everybody showed that they can play in this team.
quotes.social_post: Luka Doncic on the Lakers depth: It is just next man up mentality.

structured.context: Luka Doncic discusses the team's next-man-up mentality while teammates are sidelined due to injury.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on the team's depth and collective effort
quotes.excerpt: we're extremely deep as a team. I feel like we're either if Luka is out or AR is out
quotes.quote: We're extremely deep as a team. I feel like we're either if Luka is out or AR is out people know what we're going to do collectively as a team, do it by committee and I feel every game where one of them has been out everybody has stepped up and just contributed in either offensive ways or defensive ways as well.
quotes.social_post: Quentin Grimes says the Lakers are extremely deep and handle absences by committee.

structured.context: Quentin Grimes talks about the team's depth and collective effort when key players are unavailable.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes on Luka Doncic's ability to make the right read
quotes.excerpt: he's a one of one player for a reason. They're going to blitz him
quotes.quote: He's a one of one player for a reason. They're going to blitz him, they're going to try to triple team him when they might affect they affect like they're going to blitz him and stuff like that and he's still probably always going to make the right read nine times out of ten. So we just got to be able to give him outlets, find an open window for him so he can either make a play for himself or he will always make a play for us for sure.
quotes.social_post: Quentin Grimes on playing with Luka Doncic: He is a one of one player for a reason and he is always going to make the right read nine times out of ten.

structured.context: Quentin Grimes explains how the team supports Luka Doncic when opponents use defensive schemes like blitzing against him.
